# Everything Command-line Interface

LaunchPad includes the official 64-bit Everything command-line interface (`es.exe`)
version 1.1.0.37 to query a locally running Everything index over IPC.

- Project: https://www.voidtools.com/
- Download: https://www.voidtools.com/downloads/
- SHA-256: `3BE7185707E8023CD9295DBCB7A3FA4092A3D8F52B7FA92A0B84243AB40D12F3`

Everything is optional. When it is unavailable, LaunchPad falls back to Windows
application package discovery and its built-in scanners.
